concepts.description: A Module is a software component that encapsulates a part of the AUV system.
A RoboticPlatform is the physical or logical platform providing the AUV's capabilities.
An Interface defines a set of data Values or Events used for communication between components.
A Controller is a component that manages or directs operations within the AUV.
A PrimitiveType is a basic data type used to define simple values.
A CompositeType is a structured data type composed of multiple values.
A Value is a data element within a CompositeType or Interface.
An Event is a signal or message that can be sent or received through an interface.
A Parameter is an input value consumed by an Event or Function.
A ReturnValue is a value produced by an Event or Function.
A Function is a defined operation that takes inputs and returns an output.

instances.description: AUV_Module is the module in which the AUV system is developed.
AUV_Platform is the robotic platform contained in AUV_Module.
Sensors is an interface used by AUV_Platform.
Actuators is an interface used by AUV_Platform, currently empty.
AUV_Operator is a controller contained in AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface.
Inputs is an interface used by controllers.
LRE_Ctrl is a controller for the Last Response Engine contained in AUV_Module.
Outputs is an interface used by controllers.
AUV_Autopilot is a controller contained in AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface.
nat is a primitive type for natural numbers.
int is a primitive type for integers.
string is a primitive type for string values.
boolean is a primitive type for boolean values.
real is a primitive type for real numbers.
SVec is a composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
radial is a value of type real in SVec.
polar is a value of type real in SVec.
azimuth is a value of type real in SVec.
Obstacle is a composite type recording obstacle-related values.
ns_rel_dist is a value of type real in Obstacle.
ew_rel_dist is a value of type real in Obstacle.
depth is a value of type real in Obstacle.
id is a value of type real in Obstacle.
obs_hdng is a value of type SVec in Obstacle.
hdng is a value of type SVec in Sensors.
obs is a value of type Obstacle in Sensors.
Intpus is an interface that defines input events.
endTask is an event with no Parameters and no ReturnValue.
reqOCM is an event with no Parameters and no ReturnValue.
reqMOM is an event with no Parameters and no ReturnValue.
reqHCM is an event with no Parameters and no ReturnValue.
reqVel is an event with no Parameters and a ReturnValue of type real.
reqHdng is an event with no Parameters and a ReturnValue of type real.
advVel is an event that takes one Parameter of type real and has no ReturnValue.
advHdng is an event that takes one Parameter of type real and has no ReturnValue.
Close is a composite type recording close-related values.
horiz_cda is a value of type real in Close.
vert_cda is a value of type real in Close.
odist is a function that returns the distance from the AUV to an Obstacle as a real.
hdist is a function that returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to an Obstacle as a real.
vdist is a function that returns the vertical distance from the AUV to an Obstacle as a real.
